name: hcapp_searchHashers
description: Hasher search from Chats (E9.F1.S26, decided with James 2026-10-02). Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 143, @param NULL — device-secret token); any signed-in hasher may search. The FOUND hasher's choice (HC.Hasher.DirectoryVisibility & 3) is the only gate: 3 = anyone finds them; 1 = only people they have run with (HC6.CoRunners); 2 = only a member (HasherKennelMap.IsMember = 1, not a follower) of a kennel they are a member of; 0 / NULL = never found. Matches the hash name and the home kennel's name / short name; first name, last name and 'first last' only when the hasher also chose +16 (real name). A block either way (HasherFriendMap.Ignore = 1) hides them, and the searcher never finds themself. Results show the hasher's own display-name choice (HC.Hasher.DisplayName), names that START with the text first, then people the searcher has run with most. Scraping guards: 2..60 characters, at most 50 results, and a per-hasher limit of 30 searches a minute / 400 a day counted in LOG.GeneralLog (LogSource 'hasherSearch', Message = the user id; the search text is never logged). LIKE wildcards typed by the user are escaped and match literally. Read SP with a success envelope: the envelope is emitted only once the results exist.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then fails gracefully).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: What was typed. Default NULL; NULL/blank or fewer than 2 or more than 60 characters after trimming is refused (14300). '[', '%' and '_' are escaped so they match literally.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Auth failure ONLY (ValidateAppAuth): a single rowset with the error detail and no envelope in front of it — errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc. Note this differs from the two-rowset shape of the refusal and CATCH paths below.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Refused (14300, errorType 2: too short/long or rate limit — errorUserMessage is the user-facing refusal) or unhandled (14301, errorType 5): { success=0, errorCode, errorType }, followed by StandardErrorResult at index 1.
Follows ErrorEnvelope on the 14300 / 14301 paths. errorUserMessage on 14300 is one of 'Type at least 2 letters of a name.' or 'You have searched a lot just now. Please wait a minute and try again.'

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Success envelope, emitted after the results have been collected into #found so a failure can never follow a success row.

rowsets.name: Hashers
rowsets.description: 0..50 rows: prefix matches first, then by RunsTogether DESC, then DisplayName. Empty when nothing matched.

columns.name: PublicHasherId
columns.description: UPPER(CAST(Hasher.PublicHasherId AS NVARCHAR(40))) — identification only, never a foreign key; the app lowercases it into an HcId on arrival.

columns.name: Photo
columns.description: Hasher.Photo — profile photo URL or bundle:// avatar.

columns.name: HomeKennelName
columns.description: Kennel.KennelName of Hasher.HomeKennelId; NULL when no home kennel or it is deleted.

columns.name: RunsTogether
columns.description: Runs the searcher and this hasher attended together (HC6.CoRunners); 0 when never.

sideEffects: INSERT LOG.GeneralLog (LogSource 'hasherSearch', Message = searcher's user id, Timestamp) — one row per accepted search; this is the rate-limit counter. The query text is not logged.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on a refusal (14300, 'Hasher search refused', with the refusal reason and query length) and on an unhandled error (14301).
Creates and drops #co, #myKennels and #found temp tables.

codeSmells.issue: Two error shapes from one SP
codeSmells.detail: An auth failure (lines 49-50) returns the error detail as the ONLY rowset, while a refusal (74-76) or CATCH (153-155) returns {success, errorCode, errorType} first and the detail second. A client that reads rowset 0 as the envelope sees an auth failure as a row with no 'success' column. The other hcapp_ write SPs emit the envelope on the auth path too.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
